auth.headline: Everything you own, in one trusted place.
auth.supporting: Open your wallet, explore verified digital objects and follow every action from one secure viewer.
auth.welcomeDescription: Sign in to open your smart object inventory.
auth.createDescription: Email is the quickest way to start. You can also use a wallet or passkey.
auth.name: Display name
auth.connectWalletDescription: Use an injected EOA wallet. You will sign a short-lived login challenge; no transaction is sent.
auth.walletUnavailable: No compatible browser wallet was found.
auth.passkeyDescription: Use Face ID, Touch ID or your device PIN. Your passkey never leaves your device.
auth.tenantMissing: This Viewer host is not configured.

verify.title: Verify your account
verify.description: Enter the verification code sent to your email.
verify.resent: A new verification code is on its way.

recovery.title: Reset your password
recovery.description: Enter your email and we’ll send a secure reset link if an account exists.
recovery.sentDescription: If an account exists for that email, a password reset link has been sent.
recovery.newDescription: Use at least 8 characters and avoid reusing an old password.
recovery.updatedDescription: You can now sign in with your new password.
recovery.missingToken: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: Every smart object linked to your wallet.
inventory.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or object ID
inventory.emptyTitle: Your inventory is ready for its first object
inventory.emptyDescription: Objects issued or transferred to this wallet will appear here.

object.description: Verified identity and current smart object state.
object.sharedStatus: The public object link was copied to your clipboard.
object.shareFailed: The public object link could not be shared or copied.
object.publicDescription: View this verified public smart object.
object.publicNotFoundDescription: The public link may be incomplete, or the object may no longer be available.
object.notFound: This object was not found or is not available to your wallet.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: A verifiable timeline of actions connected to your wallet.
activity.emptyDescription: Wallet actions will appear here as they are processed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage your Viewer profile and review wallet security.
settings.profileDescription: These details are used across your smart object experience.
settings.securityDescription: Your signing method and public account details.
settings.dangerDescription: This permanently deletes your Viewer wallet account. Blockchain history cannot be deleted.
